report.panelsSubtitle: One panel per index: measurement dots, 7-day average and starting range. Only standard morning measurements count.
report.startNowSubtitle: Start (average of the first 7 reference days), average of the last 7 days, change and verdict.
report.cvHint: CV: coefficient of variation of the daily reference values in the period (standard deviation / mean).
report.regularityLine: Regularity in the period: {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} with a reference measurement out of {total}.
report.excludedNote: {count, plural, one {# measurement excluded} other {# measurements excluded}} from the calculations: {reasons}.
report.sessionsSubtitle: Before and after pairs of the same day, and morning measurement followed by a coherence session.
